commits.message:
fix(yaml): set tab/shift width to 2 for YAML files

Changed the Vim autocommand for YAML filetype to use a tabstop and
shiftwidth of 2 instead of 4. This aligns with common YAML style guides
that recommend 2-space indentation for better readability and
compatibility.
refactor(blink): remove obsidian sources and dependency
refactor(blink): remove comments
feat(floaterm): add <C-`> toggle key in all modes
Use variable for obsidian and novel-formatter dir
Updates
Updates

refactor(autosave): simplify logic and fix file checks

- Removed "acwrite" from autosave_disabled_ft list.
- Replaced deprecated vim.fn.system git checks with vim.system and
improved error code handling.
- Removed redundant check for "wezterm.lua" file.
- Changed new file detection from findfile to checking if ctx.file is
empty.
- Cleaned up autocmd group creation for autosave. These changes
modernize the autosave logic, improve reliability, and simplify the
code.
feat(plugin): modify cursor jump function
feat(plugin): disable sidekick
Update
Update

feat(keymaps): update window control mappings

Refactored window control keymaps from <Plug>(my-win) prefixed mappings
to direct 's' prefixed mappings (e.g., 'ss', 'sv', 'sc'). Introduced
a window_opts table to conditionally set remap=true for VSCode
environments, ensuring compatibility. This change simplifies window
navigation and management keybindings and improves consistency across
environments.

feat(lualine): show git diff char count in statusline

Add a char_count module that calculates and caches the number of
characters added and removed in the current Git diff. Integrate this as
a lualine component for projects with 'my-text' in their path, updating
on buffer write and enter events.

feat(wordmatch): change word highlighting

Changed word highlighting from underline to different background color,
enhancing the visibility of the word.

style(lazy): unify spacing in plugin config tables

Consistent spacing applied to key mapping and command tables in Neo-tree
and Emmet-vim plugin configurations for improved readability and style
uniformity.

feat(gitsigns): update sign symbols and disable numhl

- Changed git add/change signs from '▏' to '┋' (add) and '┃' (change)
  for both unstaged and staged states.
- Disabled line number highlighting (numhl) for clearer sign display.

refactor(keymaps): simplify MoveUntilNonWS logic

Refactored the MoveUntilNonWS function to use direct string operations
instead of cursor and line checks for determining non-whitespace and
whitespace characters. This improves readability and efficiency by
reducing redundant cursor movements and clarifying boundary conditions.

feat(emmet): enable plugin and set custom leader key

Removes disabling condition for emmet-vim, adds command trigger, and
sets <C-;> as the Emmet leader key for easier usage.

feat(config): disable image feature in plugin setup

Set `enabled = false` for the image option in the plugin configuration.
This change prevents image-related features from being activated,
possibly improving performance or avoiding unwanted image rendering.

feat(markdown): add markdown-preview.nvim plugin

Added iamcco/markdown-preview.nvim to enable live Markdown preview in
Neovim. Configured to load for Markdown files only, with commands for
preview control and a build step for setup.
Update

refactor(init): declarative dial.nvim key mappings

Move dial.nvim increment/decrement keymaps to the plugin spec's 'keys'
field for cleaner, declarative setup. Remove manual mapping code from
config function.

refactor(neo-tree): move <leader>d keymap to keys field

The <leader>d keybinding for focusing Neo-tree is now set using the
plugin's 'keys' field instead of manually in the init function. This
aligns with lazy.nvim best practices for keymap management and improves
configuration clarity.

feat(undotree): migrate keymap to lazy.nvim keys field

Refactored the Undotree plugin config to use the 'keys' field for
mapping 'U' to toggle Undotree, replacing the previous init function.
This aligns with lazy.nvim best practices and improves maintainability.

feat(todo-comments): move keymaps to lazy keys field

Refactored todo-comments.nvim plugin setup by relocating the keymap
definitions for jumping to next and previous todo comments from the
config function to the 'keys' field in lazy.nvim. This enables
declarative keymap registration and removes manual keymap setup,
improving maintainability and consistency.

refactor(treesitter): inline filetype lists in config

Removes the treesitter_filetypes variable and directly specifies
filetype lists in nvim-treesitter and nvim-treesitter-context plugin
configs. Also sets treesitter to lazy-load and clarifies LaTeX filetype
handling.

feat(colorscheme): highlight NeoTree git statuses

Add highlight links for NeoTreeGitModified and NeoTreeGitUnstaged to
DiagnosticWarn in the tokyonight setup. This visually distinguishes
modified and unstaged files in NeoTree using the warning diagnostic
style.

feat(keymap): enhance <Tab> with snippet and sidekick

Updated the <Tab> key mapping to first move forward in snippets, then
invoke sidekick's next edit suggestion, and finally fallback to default
behavior. This improves workflow efficiency by combining snippet
navigation and edit suggestions under one key.

refactor(options): move WSL clipboard config

Moved WSL-specific clipboard settings from init.lua to lua/options.lua
for better organization and clarity. The clipboard logic now checks for
    WSL first, then applies a fallback for non-VSCode environments. This
    improves maintainability and keeps environment-specific options
    grouped together.

fix(options): skip OSC 52 clipboard in VSCode

The clipboard integration using OSC 52 and the dummy paste function are
now only set when not running in VSCode. This avoids potential conflicts
or redundant clipboard handling in the VSCode environment.

feat(ui): reduce neo-tree width and disable relativenumber

- Changed neo-tree window width from 60 to 30 and max_width from 30% to
20%
- Set vim.opt.relativenumber to false on neo-tree buffer enter event
- Improves sidebar compactness and disables relative line numbers for
  clarity

feat(ui): disable highlight features in VSCode

Wrap visual selection and cursor word highlight logic in a conditional
block to prevent execution in VSCode environment. This avoids
unnecessary highlight setup when running in VSCode, ensuring
compatibility and performance.

feat(sidekick): replace Avante with Sidekick.nvim

Swaps out Avante.nvim for folke/sidekick.nvim as the AI assistant
plugin. Updates configuration to use Sidekick's CLI options and muxing
with zellij. Keybindings are revised to match Sidekick's features,
including toggling the CLI, sending selections, and opening Claude.
Removes Avante-specific build steps, dependencies, and autocmd setup.

feat(options): improve clipboard integration with OSC52

Refactored clipboard configuration to use a custom paste function and
set up Neovim's clipboard provider with OSC52 support. The change
replaces the previous simple string assignment with a table that defines
both copy and paste handlers, using the osc52 plugin for copying and
a custom function for pasting from the unnamed register. This enhances
compatibility and reliability of clipboard operations between Neovim and
the OS.

fix(treesitter): add 'tex' filetype for context plugin

Previously, only 'latex' was included in the Treesitter filetypes, which
meant that the 'nvim-treesitter-context' plugin did not activate for
'tex' files. This change adds 'tex' to the filetypes for the plugin,
ensuring that context features work for both 'latex' and 'tex' files.
The comment is also updated to clarify the distinction between 'latex'
(for Treesitter) and 'tex' (for Vim).

feat(autosave): disable autosave in VSCode env

Autosave autocmds and logic are now only set up when not running in
VSCode (`Env.is_vscode`). This prevents autosave from interfering in
VSCode environments, where it may be undesirable or redundant.

feat(autocmd): restrict csv/tsv formatting to Linux

Autocmds for formatting CSV and TSV files using the column utility and
regex replacements are now only registered if the environment is Linux.
This prevents potential issues on non-Linux systems where the commands
may not be available or behave differently.
fixup! feat(treesitter): add fish filetype support
fixup! feat(treesitter): add fish filetype support

feat(gitsigns): show inline hunk preview after nav

Disable built-in preview for hunk navigation and add a deferred inline
hunk preview after moving to next/previous hunk. Improves visual
feedback by showing changes inline instead of popup.

fix(plugin): update scroll enable check for SSH

Replace VSCode environment check with SSH check for scroll feature
enablement in plugin config. This ensures scrolling is disabled when
running over SSH instead of in VSCode.

feat(treesitter): add fish filetype support

Added 'fish' to the Treesitter filetypes list in init.lua. This enables
syntax highlighting and parsing for Fish shell scripts in Neovim.

feat(options): switch clipboard to osc52 protocol

Replaces 'unnamedplus' clipboard setting with 'osc52' via
vim.g.clipboard. This enables clipboard integration using the OSC52
protocol, which is useful for remote or SSH sessions. Removes outdated
comment about clipboard sync.

feat(ui): enable scroll except in Neovide/VSCode

The scroll feature is now enabled by default, except when running in
Neovide or VSCode environments. This change improves usability by
allowing scroll functionality in supported environments while
maintaining compatibility with Neovide and VSCode where scrolling may
not be desired.

style(dashboard): remove extra space in Oil menu item

A space after the comma in the Oil menu item definition was removed for
consistency with other items in the dashboard menu list. No functional
changes.

refactor(autosave): use vim.b for buffer state

Switch autosave buffer state tracking from vapi.nvim_buf_set_var to
native vim.b table. Update autosave logic to check
vim.b.autosave_enabled directly, improving reliability and performance.

feat(keymaps): <C-\> sets tab-local dir to buffer path

Change <C-\> mapping to use :tcd instead of :cd, making it set the
working directory locally for the tab to the current buffer's directory.
Adds logic to handle non-file buffers gracefully.

feat(oil): add dashboard shortcut and cmd config

- Added a dashboard shortcut for Oil with icon and keybinding.
- Updated oil.nvim plugin config to include "Oil" and "OilOpen"
commands.
- Improves accessibility and integration of Oil file explorer.

fix(autosave): improve buffer autosave exclusion logic

- Use BufReadPost for autosave autocmd for better timing.
- Disable autosave for untracked git files, certain filetypes, and
suffixes.
- Show notification when autosave is disabled for a buffer.
- Simplify autosave function by relying on buffer variable.

feat(treesitter): add LaTeX support for 'tex' files

Include 'tex' in the Treesitter filetype list to enable syntax
highlighting and code navigation for LaTeX files. This change ensures
that Treesitter features are available when editing LaTeX documents in
Neovim.

feat(image): enhance LaTeX math rendering config

Added detailed configuration for LaTeX math image rendering, including
font size, required packages, and a custom document template. The
template now includes more packages for better compatibility and avoids
local .sty files, improving markdown and LaTeX document support.

feat(options): add 'hiddenoff' to diffopt setting

Include 'hiddenoff' in diffopt to exclude hidden buffers from diff view,
improving clarity when comparing files.

feat(plugins): add image support and shareedit config

- Enabled image support in mini.nvim by adding image = {}.
- Added vim-shareedit plugin (disabled by default) for sharing edits
  with VSCode, including denops.vim dependency.

feat(gitsigns): add greedy option to hunk navigation

Added `greedy = false` to the hunk navigation options for gitsigns. This
change adjusts the navigation behavior, making it less aggressive when
moving between hunks. It provides finer control over how hunks are
selected during navigation.

feat(colorscheme): switch to tokyonight.nvim

Replaced the Iceberg colorscheme plugin and its extensive custom
highlight configuration with the Tokyonight plugin. The new setup
applies minimal highlight customizations and sets the colorscheme to
'tokyonight-moon' for improved aesthetics and maintainability.

refactor(treesitter): remove redundant 'tex' filetype

The 'tex' filetype was removed from the treesitter_filetypes list
because it is already covered by 'latex'. This avoids redundancy and
clarifies the configuration.

feat(gitsigns): enable inline hunk preview on nav

Previously, navigating between hunks with custom keys triggered
a delayed inline preview using `vim.defer_fn`. This change removes the
deferred preview and instead sets the `preview` option to `true` in the
navigation options (`hunk_nav_opts`). Now, inline hunk previews are
shown immediately when navigating, simplifying the logic and improving
responsiveness.

feat(snippet): add debugpy attach snippet for Python

Added a new snippet triggered by "debugpy" that inserts Python code to
conditionally start and wait for a debugpy debugger session if the
DEBUGPY environment variable is set. This helps in remote debugging
scenarios, printing helpful messages and handling missing debugpy
installation gracefully.

feat: add initial main.py with hello world

Added a new Python script main.py that prints "Hello, world!". This
serves as the initial entry point for the application.

feat(keymaps): update CopilotChat and window nav keys

- Removed <C-k> CopilotChat keymaps in visual/normal mode from lazy.nvim
config.
- Kept only <leader>- and <leader>9 CopilotChat keymaps for prompt
actions and open.
- Added <C-j> and <C-k> mappings for window navigation in normal mode in
  keymaps.lua, enabling easier movement between windows.

feat(dap): use Lua functions for step keys

Replaced DAP step key mappings (<F10>, <F11>, <F12>) from command
strings to direct Lua function calls. This change improves reliability
and allows for better integration with the nvim-dap API.

feat(bufferline): enable diagnostics, clean separators

Enabled diagnostics display for errors and hints in bufferline
configuration, while keeping warnings and info disabled. Also removed
custom separator settings for buffer visibility states (alternate,
current, inactive, visible) to simplify the config.

fix(git): fix neogit log mapping for <leader>gl

The mapping for <leader>gl (Git log) was refactored to wrap the function
body in a block. This fixes a syntax issue and ensures the mapping works
as intended with the correct options and description.

refactor(barbar): migrate config to opts for lazy.nvim

The configuration for the 'barbar.nvim' plugin was updated to use the
'opts' key instead of a custom 'config' function in the lazy.nvim setup.
The redundant manual disabling of auto-setup was removed. All bufferline
icon and appearance settings are now provided directly via the 'opts'
table, aligning with lazy.nvim's recommended configuration style and
simplifying the plugin setup.

feat(oil): refactor <leader>E mapping for clarity

Refactored the key mapping for <leader>E in the Oil plugin setup. The
mapping is now defined as a table for improved readability and
consistency, explicitly specifying the function and its description. No
functional changes were made.

refactor(neogit): migrate mappings to plugin keys

Moved all neogit-related key mappings from manual map() calls in the
config function to the 'keys' table in the plugin spec for better
clarity and maintainability. Replaced the 'config' function with 'opts'
for plugin setup. Also removed the autocmd for closing the status tab
    with <BS>. This streamlines neogit integration and aligns with
    lazy.nvim best practices.

feat(ui): underline CursorWord instead of background

Changed the CursorWord highlight style from a background color
(guibg=#2a2e41) to an underline (gui=underline). This improves
visibility and reduces background color distractions when highlighting
the word under the cursor.

feat(cmdline): add :sd abbreviation for substitution

Added a new command-line abbreviation `:sd` similar to the existing
`:ss`. When typing `:sd`, it expands to a substitution command with the
cursor positioned three characters before the end, making it easier to
edit the replacement part. This improves efficiency for users frequently
editing substitution commands.

refactor(oil): migrate to new lazy.nvim keymap/opts style

Refactored the oil.nvim plugin config to use the new `keys` and `opts`
fields supported by lazy.nvim, replacing the previous manual keymap
setup and config function. Keymaps are now specified declaratively, and
plugin options are passed via `opts`. This improves clarity and
maintainability of the configuration.

feat(dap): open DAP UI on F6 continue

The key mapping for <F6> in normal mode was updated to first open the
DAP UI (`dapui.open()`) before executing the DAP continue command. This
ensures the debug UI is visible whenever continuing execution, improving
the debugging workflow.

refactor(autosave): clarify exclusion logic for files

Moved "wezterm.lua" exclusion from initial branch to the secondary
conditional, improving readability and separation of concerns in
autosave logic. Now, autosave returns early for unmodified or new files,
and handles "wezterm.lua" and other disabling conditions in a distinct
branch.

feat(help): auto move help window right and resize

Add an ftplugin for help buffers that moves the help window to the far
right and sets its width to 105 columns. This enhances the usability and
readability of help documentation in Neovim.

style(autosave): fix indentation for condition branches

Adjusted indentation of conditional branches in the autosave function
for improved readability and consistency. No logic changes were made.

refactor(git): remove outdated comment from commit mapping

The comment about lazy loading and errors for the <leader>gc mapping was
removed. The mapping itself is unchanged and still calls neogit.action
directly.

fix(gitdiff): extract commit message from response.content

Update callback to use response.content for extracting commit message,
ensuring compatibility with updated response structure.

feat(python): update nvim-dap-python setup

- Remove 'nvim-dap-python' from dependencies array.
- Add explicit plugin config for 'mfussenegger/nvim-dap-python'.
- Change dap-python setup to use 'uv' instead of venv python path.
- Add dependency on 'mfussenegger/nvim-dap'.

feat(autosave): disable autosave for untracked files

Refactor autosave logic to prevent autosaving buffers for files not
tracked by git. Improves reliability by checking file tracking status
with git and updating notification messages for clarity. Also
restructures filetype checks for readability.

feat(todo-comments): add keymaps for navigation

Added custom config for folke/todo-comments.nvim to set up keymaps: ]t
for next todo comment and [t for previous. This enhances navigation
    between todo comments in normal mode.

feat(dial): add True/False and true/false augends

Added two new cyclic constant augends for boolean values:
- "True"/"False" (capitalized)
- "true"/"false" (lowercase) This enables quick toggling of these values
in code using dial.nvim.

feat(autosave): disable autosave for .gitignore and .ipynb

- Added "gitignore" to autosave_disabled_ft to prevent autosave for
.gitignore files.
- Introduced autosave_disabled_suffix to disable autosave for files
ending with ".ipynb".
- Updated autosave logic to check both filetype and file suffix before
saving.
- Shows warning when leaving buffer with unsaved changes for these
  files.

feat(keymaps): add toggle for diff mode in all windows

Added a keymap to toggle diff mode for all buffers in all windows. Uses
'windo diffthis' to enable and 'diffoff!' to disable diff mode. Prints
a message indicating the current diff state.

feat(init): add todo-comments and improve plugin setup

- Add folke/todo-comments.nvim plugin for TODO management
- Clarify and update comments for several plugins
- Disable fuzzy-motion.vim by default
- Use vim.hl.on_yank for yank highlight autocmd
- Refine plugin conditions and event triggers
- Minor formatting and readability improvements

feat(markdown): improve readability with linebreak

Added 'setlocal linebreak' to the Markdown filetype plugin. This ensures
that wrapped lines break at word boundaries, making long lines easier to
read in the editor.

feat(floaterm): enable <C-z> in operator-pending mode

Added 'o' (operator-pending) to the <C-z> key mapping for
FloatermToggle. This allows users to toggle Floaterm while in
operator-pending mode, improving consistency across editing states.

feat(tex): make <F6> mapping do full VimtexClean

<F6> now runs :VimtexClean! instead of :VimtexClean, ensuring all
auxiliary files are removed after compiling. This helps keep the project
directory cleaner.

feat(keymaps): set localleader to backslash and update mappings

Set vim.g.maplocalleader to '\' in init.lua for clarity. Update
toggle_prefix in keymaps.lua to match new localleader. Ensures
consistency between leader key config and keymaps.

refactor(git integration): clarify comments and fix response handling

Clarified comment for commit message pasting in gitcommit window logic.
Fixed extraction of commit message from response object in
GenAndCopyCommitMsg callback to use response.content, improving
reliability.

feat(ui): lower line opacity and ignore some filetypes

Reduced line_opacity to 0.1 for subtler highlight effect. Added ignore
list for 'text', 'markdown', 'markdown.mdx', and 'tex' filetypes to
disable line highlighting in those buffers.

docs(readme): add contribution guidelines section

Added a "How to Contribute" section to README.md with step-by-step
instructions for forking, cloning, branching, making changes, and
submitting pull requests. This helps new contributors understand the
process for contributing to the project.

style(gitcommit): fix indentation in commit handler

Adjusted indentation for commands in the gitcommit filetype handler to
improve code readability and maintain consistent formatting. No
functional changes were made.

fix(ui): set window width as number not string

Changed the 'width' property in the window configuration from a string
('60') to a number (60). This ensures the configuration uses the correct
data type, which may prevent potential type-related issues in the UI
rendering logic.

feat(cmp): add blink-cmp-spell for spell suggestions

Added 'ribru17/blink-cmp-spell' as a dependency and configured it as
a new completion source for nvim-cmp. The spell source is enabled for
markdown and other filetypes, but only activates in Treesitter @spell
captures and is disabled in @nospell captures. This enhances spelling
suggestions contextually during completion, especially in markdown
files.

feat(keymaps): swap p and P in visual mode paste

Swapped the behavior of 'p' and 'P' in visual mode so that pressing 'p'
pastes without overwriting the unnamed register, and 'P' pastes with the
default behavior. This helps prevent accidental overwriting of the
register when pasting over a selection.

feat(jpmoveword): load only if novel_formatter exists

The plugin 'swnakamura/jpmoveword.vim' is now conditionally loaded based
on the existence of the '~/ghq/github.com/swnakamura/novel_formatter'
directory. This prevents loading the plugin unless the related formatter
is present, optimizing plugin management for Japanese text editing
workflows.

fix(git): use normal! and return nil for commit msg

- Use `normal!` instead of `normal` to avoid custom mappings when
  pasting in the gitcommit window.
- Change function return from empty string to nil for clarity and
  idiomatic Lua.

fix(commit): auto-wrap commit message at 72 chars

Add a command to automatically wrap the commit message at 72 characters
after pasting it in the gitcommit buffer. Also update the commit message
generation prompt to remove redundant wrapping instructions.

refactor(config): improve LSP, treesitter, and keymaps

- Update plugin setups and fix variable naming for clarity
- Enhance LSP and Treesitter support for bash, zsh, and sh
- Add shellcheck linting to efm language server configuration
- Adjust keymap for tab management and correct toggle prefix
- Disable vimtex quickfix feature for cleaner workflow
- Set line numbering per window and remove redundant buffer option
- Replace global line numbering with buffer-local settings

feat(tex): enable spell checking for TeX buffers

Added 'setlocal spell' to the TeX filetype plugin. This enables spell
checking in TeX buffers, helping users catch spelling mistakes while
editing LaTeX documents.

refactor(luasnip): simplify snippet definitions

Refactor LuaSnip snippet setup by introducing local variables for
add_snippets and parse_snippet. This reduces repetition and improves
readability in snippet definitions across multiple languages. No
functional changes are introduced.
